context: Professional, production-ready, mobile-friendly web application for Marathi cultural organization Nabhrang (नभरंग - Cultural Theatre, Literature & Arts Foundation). PHP + MySQL architecture with dynamic admin panel for managing organization settings, site settings, members, payments, homepage, and registration.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle theatrical stage red and gold velvet feel with warm amber highlights

tables: settings (id, setting_key, setting_value_mr, setting_value_en, group_name, updated_at)
site_sections (id, section_name, title_mr, title_en, content_mr, content_en, status, sort_order)
members (id, full_name_mr, full_name_en, email, phone, membership_type, status, joined_date, created_at)
payments (id, member_id, amount, payment_method, transaction_id, status, payment_date)
registrations (id, event_name_mr, event_name_en, participant_name, phone, status, registered_at)
admin_users (id, username, password_hash, full_name, role, last_login, created_at)
audit_logs (id, admin_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, ip_address, created_at)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build complete PHP + MySQL backend architecture with PDO prepared statements and robust session security.
Implement Maria-first bilingual UI with English ready fields and dynamic database settings loader (no hardcoded org info).
Create a fully featured Admin Panel with Admin Login, Dashboard, Organization Settings, Site Settings, Members, Payments, Registrations, and Audit Logs.
Ensure cPanel / shared hosting compatibility with clean .htaccess routing and structured modular PHP files.
Style with theatrical crimson and gold velvet aesthetic (#8B1E24 and #D4AF37) keeping mobile responsiveness and accessibility in mind.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never hardcode organization name, contact info, or banner content into PHP/HTML templates; fetch dynamically from the settings table.
Always use PDO prepared statements for all database queries to prevent SQL injection.
Enforce PHP Sessions, password_hash() / password_verify(), CSRF tokens, and role-based authorization for admin routes.
Include data-testid attributes on all buttons, inputs, and interactive elements for robust automated testing.
